summary: Router 0.30.0 adds roles.<r>.options (sampling defaults, ADR-0093). Traced: config load and schema (config.py _parse_roles, role_options, SCHEMA), admin PUT/GET (admin.py _roles_from, config.roles_as_config), request building (proxy._backend_body, dispatch, _Relay), the OpenAI-compatible node path (openai_node.run -> cloud.openai_exchange local_server=True) and the cloud provider path (cloud.run -> openai_exchange local_server=False, _oa_body unchanged). Two issues found during the review and fixed before the PR: (1) non-numeric client sampling values would have been forwarded raw to OpenAI-compatible nodes - now only int/float (not bool) pass; (2) role defaults would have reached a cloud model used as canary/shadow, because those tier dicts carry no cloud key - the node's is_cloud now decides as well. Role values are validated (known keys, types, ranges, NaN/inf refused). No new route, no change to authentication, CSRF, data classes or the final cloud payload.

findings.evidence: cloud.openai_exchange forwarded options.top_k/min_p/penalties for local_server as given; a client value of any JSON type (string, object) would have reached the node unchecked.
findings.resolution: Only int/float values that are not bool are forwarded; test 'rejected case: a client's non-numeric sampling values never reach the node' in test/selftest_role_options.py.

findings.evidence: proxy._backend_body skipped role defaults only when tier['cloud'] was set; canary/shadow tiers (config._parse_roles, ops.py) carry no cloud key, so a cloud canary would have received e.g. temperature 0 (refused by gpt-5 models, B6 payload change).
findings.resolution: Defaults are skipped when tier['cloud'] or node.is_cloud; test 'rejected case: a canary tier on a cloud provider (no `cloud` key) gets no role defaults'.

tests.evidence: ALL GREEN, including the rejected cases (unknown key, typo, bool, string, float top_k, out of range, invalid override unchanged, cloud tier, cloud canary, non-numeric client values, cloud provider unchanged)
332 PASS, 0 failures on the final code (second run after the two fixes)
configuration ok: 5 roles, 7 models in the catalog
OK; control flow ok: 0 legacy findings

limitations: Not run against a real Ollama node or a real OpenAI-compatible server; node behaviour for the newly forwarded keys (top_k clamping, penalty windows) is the server's.
The effect on answer quality is measured for one voice question only (ADR-0093).
PostgreSQL integrations not run (no session store touched).
A role's options also apply to every local fallback tier of the role, including other models; operators choose values that suit all of them (documented).
